text:
FIFA World Cup a ɛtɔ so 10 no, wɔde kɔɔ West Germany wɔ 13 June kɔsi 7 July 1974, na wɔgyee teams 16 ano wɔ format a ɛnyɛ sɛ knockout a ɛwɔ mprempren no. Round a ɛdi kan no, wɔkyekyee teams no mu kɔɔ groups anan a ɛwɔ teams anan mu, na top two wɔ group biara kɔɔ round a ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɛwɔ groups mmienu foforo a ɛwɔ teams anan mu. Nnipa anka semi-finals knockout: group winners a ɛwɔ round a ɛtɔ so mmienu no hyiaa wɔ final no mu, na runners-up no bɔɔ match a ɛfa third-place ho. Tournament no nso de FIFA World Cup Trophy a ɛwɔ mprempren no bae, a wɔde bae ɛfiri sɛ Brazil kuraa Jules Rimet Trophy no daa wɔ bere a wɔdi nkunim wɔ 1970 mu.

Early rounds no de one of the competition's most charged encounters bae. Wɔ first-round group match a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Hamburg no, East Germany, a ɛyɛ wɔn first World Cup appearance, dii West Germany nkunim 1-0 wɔ meeting a ɛyɛ politically loaded. Ɛyɛ bere a ɛdi kan na German sides mmienu no bɛhyia, nanso West Germany san wɔn ho bio kɔɔ nkunim na wɔdi tournament no nkunim. Netherlands, a Johan Cruyff hyɛɛ no den, de wɔn 'Total Football' a ɛyɛ fluid no kɔɔ so, na Poland nso bae sɛ surprise force, na Grzegorz Lato agobɔ no hyɛɛ no den.

Final no, a wɔbɔɔ wɔ 78,200 spectators anim wɔ Munich's Olympiastadion wɔ 7 July, hyɛɛ ase wɔ drama mu. Johan Neeskens dii penalty no nkunim wɔ second minute no mu de Netherlands kɔɔ anim, ɛyɛ penalty a wɔde maa wɔn wɔ World Cup final mu a ɛdi kan. Paul Breitner san dii nkunim wɔ penalty a ɔno nso bɔɔ wɔ 25th minute no mu, ɛyɛ spot-kick a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ match no mu na ɛyɛ one to each side, ansa na Gerd Muller abɔ winner no wɔ 43rd minute no mu. West Germany dii nkunim 2-1 de faa wɔn title a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mfe 20 akyi wɔ bere a wɔdi nkunim wɔ 1954 mu.

Netherlands dii nkunim sɛ runners-up, na Poland dii Brazil nkunim de faa third place. Grzegorz Lato wɔ Poland na ɔyɛ tournament no top scorer wɔ goals 7. Golden Ball a ɛwɔ official mu nni hɔ wɔ 1974; FIFA's Best Young Player recognition kɔɔ Poland's Wladyslaw Zmuda. Wɔ matches no nyinaa mu no, total attendance kɔɔ 1,865,753, na ɛyɛ average roughly 49,099 per game.
